correction.problem: The detached teacher probability branch was stopped, but final DFM logits include the native base-policy logits additively. KL therefore still had a student-side gradient path into the shared policy head.
correction.scientific_violation: This contradicted the preregistered requirement that policy_distillation gradients update the DFM/encoder student but not its policy-head teacher.
correction.fix: Use final_root + stop_gradient(base_root) - base_root as the student logits for KL. Its forward value is bit-identical to final_root, while the additive base-head gradient cancels exactly; DFM residual and encoder paths remain trainable.

quarantined_diagnostic.disposition: engineering evidence only; excluded from coefficient selection, matched comparison, promotion, and all candidate claims
